title: Pardon the Intrusion, You're in My Home!?
overview: Rinko's blissful otaku life is torn down when her two neighbors assign her as a chef and pretend-girlfriend.

title: Starting with a Pretend Boyfriend?!
overview: Satsuki is full of mystery... Usada and Rinko try to guess what his job is!

title: Meanwhile...?!
overview: A trio of newbie mangakas are introduced and Satsuki's secrets are finally revealed! Maybe?

title: I Don't Have Writer's Block, Okay?!
overview: Usada needs to write about love. But how could he, if he's never even had a crush before?

title: This is a work of fiction, okay?!
overview: Rinko and Satsuki need to put their fake relationship to the test with a fake date... But it feels so real?

title: It's Just a Kiss?!
overview: Rinko realizes that she likes Satsuki, but doesn't know how to tell him. Usada tries to help, but then he...?!

title: Busy? On Christmas?!
overview: The trio plans a Christmas dinner together but soon realizes they will all be busy that day.

title: Mao Stands for "Mom's Adultery Outcome"?!
overview: Mao runs away from home after finding out that her dad is not her real dad?! She goes to the trio for help.

title: Satsuki-san's Secret?!
overview: Satsuki won't tell Rinko and Usada his pen name, raising suspicions. And why is Kanisawa keep being mentioned?

title: The Pathetic Puppy Plan?!
overview: Pome's got a plan to get Valentine's chocolates from Rinko! But first, he needs his story green lit.

title: How They All Collapse?!
overview: Satsuki's editor, Fukami, approaches Rinko and demands she stays away from him and Usada.

title: Pardon the Intrusion Once More?!
overview: Things just aren't the same with the walls patched up, and it's hard to pretend that everything's fine...
